info.description: ATLAS personal stylist API (web and mobile). Errors always use ErrorResponse; branch on `code`. Web clients authenticate with HttpOnly cookies, mobile clients send `X-Atlas-Client: mobile` to the auth routes and `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` everywhere else. See docs/architecture/sessions.md and media.md.
